description:
Free open-source YouTube downloader GUI based on yt-dlp for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Download videos, Shorts, 4K, 1080p60, HDR, and subtitles with no ads, tracking, cookies, or login. Supports 9 languages.

Arroxy is a free, open-source desktop app for downloading YouTube videos and Shorts in up to 4K, 1080p60, HDR, and audio-only formats with no ads, tracking, or login required.
Install
Windows Setup Windows Portable
macOS Apple Silicon macOS Intel
Linux AppImage Linux Flatpak Linux tar.gz
SHA256
Arroxy's website has a new address: https://orionus.dev/arroxy/.
Highlights
- New website address. The About, Share, and update "Download" links now open https://orionus.dev/arroxy/. Old links to arroxy.orionus.dev, including the ones in earlier versions of Arroxy, keep working and forward to the new address.
- Feedback diagnostics upload to the new address too. Uploads from earlier versions keep working unchanged.
What's Changed
- feat(feedback-worker): accept uploads on the orionus.dev/arroxy subpath by @antonio-orionus in #251
- feat: point the app at the website's new address, orionus.dev/arroxy by @antonio-orionus in #252
